purpose: Record sourcing identity/compliance facts that materially affect procurement language. This is not legal advice and does not authorize purchase/import.

items.material: 小叶紫檀 / Red Sanders / Pterocarpus santalinus
items.identity_rule: Project must separate seller claims of Indian Pterocarpus santalinus from unrelated woods marketed with similar Chinese trade names, including 赞比亚血檀/赞比亚小叶紫檀.
items.market_risk: Public Yiwu listings show extremely cheap 赞比亚血檀/赞比亚小叶紫檀 products next to much higher-priced seller-claimed Indian small-leaf red-sanders products. They must not be interpreted as low/high tiers of one material.

eu_cites_current.listing: Pterocarpus santalinus (II) #7, Red sandalwood, Annex B
eu_cites_current.annotation_7: Designates logs, wood-chips, powder and extracts.
eu_cites_current.project_interpretation: The current #7 scope is form-specific. Finished drilled beads/finished bracelets are not among the parts named in #7, so the project must not automatically label finished bead procurement as if it were controlled raw-log trade solely because the species is listed. If import documentation is material to a real transaction, confirm the exact product form with the competent national CITES authority before purchase/import.

eu_general_guidance.evidence: EU wildlife-trade rules implement CITES; documentation depends on species/product/origin and national authorities advise on applicable permit requirements.

items.pricing_model_recommendation: Keep under ordinary wood sourcing for now, but add a mandatory species-identity gate before treating a supplier quote as genuine small-leaf red sandalwood evidence. Do not promote to SPECIALIST_MATERIAL solely because of CITES #7.
